$comment: Reviewed, intentional differences from the golden baseline, read by tests/e2e/route-inventory.spec.ts. Only soft fields can be approved: description, keywords, og:title, og:description, og:image:alt, og:site_name, og:locale, og:type, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image:alt. Shape: routes["/path"]["field"] = { "value": "exact new text" | null (removed), "reason": "why" }. Hard fields (title, canonical, og:url, robots, OG image, anchors, JSON-LD coverage, EnquiryRouter intent, print hooks, headers, sitemap order, redirects) cannot be approved here. An approval that matches the baseline again fails as stale. The top-level "visible" list is a review log, not read by the tests: every intentional change to visible page copy, link targets or a recorded deviation from the design spec, as { routes, change, reason }.

visible.change: 'Start a business enquiry' (hero chevron, sectors routing cell, closing pill) goes to /contact instead of /partnerships.
visible.reason: C0: the same general enquiry target as every site-wide Enquire action.

visible.change: Mobile quick-contact bar: Call, WhatsApp and Email are quiet icon-over-label actions and the one pill is Enquire (to /contact); the Email pill is gone. The tel:, wa.me/ and mailto: hrefs are unchanged.
visible.reason: C0: the plan's 'Call · WhatsApp · Enquire'; the mailto: action stays for conversion tracking and the QuickContact contract.

(dropped 'on the Tanzania–Zambia border'); sectors lede rewritten as 'Start from your need: each sector opens onto its service, the company behind it and the way to enquire.'; corridor lede shortened to '..., with direct access to cross-border flows.'.

visible.reason: C0: the branch row restated the Branches table directly above it (critic round 3).

visible.change: Deviation: the company hero sets its photograph beside the text (square, 440px column) rather than below it, whenever the photograph is not a 2000px landscape master.
visible.reason: C0: the only strong Westsides and Enterprises frames are phone-resolution portraits (the WESTSIDES signboard, the tanker); a 1068px frame would show them soft. Square keeps the text and the photograph about the same height.

visible.change: Deviation: at 360px the home h1 renders at about 40px, below display-xl's 48px floor.
visible.reason: The no-split rule for 'Tanzania–Zambia' takes precedence: the compound is about 7.6em wide and must fit the 316px line; the h1 still leads every other heading by 1.2x or more.

visible.change: 404 page rebuilt: the title renders once as 'Page Not Found | Itemba Group' (was 'Page Not Found | Itemba Group | Itemba Group'); the h1 is 'Page not found' (was a giant '404' h1 over an h2 'Page Not Found'); the actions are the 'Back to home' pill and 'Contact the group office ›' (was Back to Home / Our Companies / Services buttons), followed by 'Three companies. Six sectors.' and the three company cards (home's tile copy, 'Explore ›'); the page no longer inherits home's canonical; robots stays noindex.
visible.reason: WP2.8 (architecture §6: no double suffix, h1 'Page not found', noindex; plan: a calm light page that links home). A mistyped company or service address is the likeliest way to a 404, so the companies are one click away; the footer directory follows.

visible.change: New src/app/error.tsx and src/app/global-error.tsx: a calm light page, 'Something went wrong', a 'Try again' pill, 'Back to home ›' and the group office (global-error adds Call, WhatsApp and Email, since the site shell is gone); robots noindex; the error message is never shown, only Next's digest as a reference.
visible.reason: WP2.8 (architecture §1 and §6): origin/main had no error boundaries, so a runtime error showed Next's bare default.

visible.change: Adds 'Disallow: /api/' under 'User-Agent: *' (Allow: / and the Sitemap line unchanged).
visible.reason: WP2.8 (architecture §6): the enquiry endpoint and the health probe are not pages.

visible.change: The /logo.png icon (declared 512x512, really a 930x360 white lockup) is removed; the three square PNG icons stay. The description is the flag-resolved group description (no 'and manufacturing', as on home); lang is the html lang 'en' (was 'en-TZ') and background/theme colours are the canvas #ffffff (was #080f1e).
visible.reason: WP2.8 (architecture §6: drop the mis-sized logo entry, lang matches html). The description follows flags.mentionManufacturing = false, the same approval as home's meta description; the colours match the light shell and the theme-color meta.

visible.change: lastmod now comes from each page's content updatedAt (src/content/*) instead of one hard-coded date; the 25 URLs, order, priorities and changefreq are unchanged, and today's dates are the same (2026-05-14).
visible.reason: WP2.8 (architecture §6): a content edit moves only the pages it touches.

visible.change: Responses no longer carry 'X-Powered-By: Next.js' (poweredByHeader: false); the staging hosts staging-www.itembagrouptz.com and www-staging.itembagrouptz.com answer 'X-Robots-Tag: noindex'. Production hosts, redirects and every other header are unchanged.
visible.reason: WP2.8 (architecture §6 next.config additions): staging ran the production image with production canonicals and an allow-all robots.txt.
